newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Johor Port debuts at 4.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Johor Port debuts at 4.50 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's Johor Port Bhd made its debut on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday at 4.50 ringgit, against a 2.30 ringgit offer price.
At 0135 GMT, the stock of Malaysia's third largest port was trading at 4.40 ringgit.
Its stock offering totalled 68.93 million shares.
The company operates the Pasir Gudang port in the southern state of Johor.
In 1995, it reported a net profit of 43.73 million ringgit or earnings per share of 43.73 cents on a turnover of 172.87 million ringgit.
It has forecast a net profit of 53.23 million ringgit or 18.27 cents a share for the year ending Dec. 31, 1996.
A research report by HLG Securities puts a fair value of 3.70 ringgit on Johor Port, or 19 times estimated 1997 earnings.
